# Emerald Masonry LLC

# Last updated: 2026-08-08

> Non-union, family-owned commercial masonry contractor serving Chicagoland with 40+ years of experience. Licensed, bonded, and insured in Illinois.

Emerald Masonry LLC provides professional masonry restoration and repair services for commercial properties, HOAs, churches, property managers, and insurance companies across the greater Chicago area. The company is based in Palos Heights, IL and serves all of Chicagoland. Minimum project size is $5,000. Free on-site estimates provided for all qualifying projects.

## Services

Emerald Masonry LLC performs the following masonry services for both residential and commercial properties across Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs:

- **Tuckpointing & Repointing** (/services/tuckpointing): Full-depth mortar joint removal and replacement with color- and hardness-matched mortar. The most important maintenance task for brick in Chicago's freeze-thaw climate.
- **Chimney Repair** (/services/chimney-repair): Crown repair, tuckpointing, cap and flashing work, and full chimney rebuilds. The chimney is the most weather-exposed masonry on a building and fails first.
- **Brick Repair** (/services/brick-repair): Repair of cracked, spalling, and damaged brick, addressing the water or movement causing it.
- **Brick Replacement** (/services/brick-replacement): Cutting out failed brick and resetting matching or salvaged units so the repair disappears into the wall.
- **Lintel Repair** (/services/lintel-repair): Replacing rusting steel lintels above windows and doors and rebuilding the masonry above, stopping rust-jacking damage.
- **Parapet Wall Repair** (/services/parapet-wall-repair): Repointing, coping and through-wall flashing, and rebuilds of roofline masonry to stop leaks at the source.
- **Foundation Masonry Repair** (/services/foundation-masonry-repair): Repointing and brick/block replacement on foundation walls, with water-entry correction.
- **Limestone & Sill Repair** (/services/limestone-sill-repair): Crack and spall repair, Dutchman splices, and replacement of limestone and cast-stone sills, bands, and trim.
- **Masonry Caulking & Joint Sealant** (/services/caulking): Flexible sealant for expansion/control joints and window/door perimeters where rigid mortar can't go.
- **Masonry Sealing & Waterproofing** (/services/masonry-sealing, /services/waterproofing): Breathable penetrating water repellents applied after repairs, plus efflorescence removal.
- **Commercial Masonry Restoration** (/services/commercial-masonry-restoration, /services/commercial): Multi-elevation tuckpointing, brick and CMU repair, parapet and lintel work, with written scopes and phased plans.
- **Residential Masonry Restoration** (/services/residential-masonry-restoration): Whole-home brick and stone rehabilitation as one coordinated plan with matched materials.
- **Historic Masonry Restoration** (/services/historic-masonry-restoration, /services/masonry-restoration): Lime-mortar repointing and period-sensitive brick and stone repair that preserves the building's fabric.
- **Insurance Restoration**: Storm, hail, and freeze-thaw damage documentation and repair, working directly with carriers, TPAs, and adjusters.

## Who We Work With

- Property management companies managing commercial and multi-unit residential portfolios
- HOA boards overseeing shared masonry structures
- Churches, schools, and institutional property owners
- Commercial building owners and investors
- Insurance carriers and TPAs handling masonry damage claims
- General contractors requiring masonry subcontractor

## Why Emerald Masonry LLC

- 40+ years of combined Chicagoland masonry experience
- Non-union, family-owned — no union markups passed to clients
- Licensed, bonded, and insured in the state of Illinois
- Commercial and institutional focus — not a residential patch crew
- Free on-site estimates for all qualifying projects (minimum $5,000)
- Same-business-day response to estimate requests
- Works directly with insurance carriers and adjusters on claims
- Provides written scopes, before-and-after photo documentation, and certificates of completion
- Phased project scheduling available for large buildings across multiple budget cycles

Emerald Masonry LLC serves all of Chicagoland including:

**Counties**: Cook County, DuPage County, Lake County, Will County, Kane County, McHenry County

**Cities and Suburbs**: Chicago, Orland Park, Tinley Park, Frankfort, Mokena, New Lenox, Plainfield, Bolingbrook, Joliet, Lockport, Romeoville, Naperville, Downers Grove, Westmont, Burr Ridge, La Grange, Oak Lawn, Lemont, Wheaton, Homer Glen, Palos Heights, Palos Hills, Worth, Blue Island, Calumet City, Harvey, Dolton, Lansing, Matteson, Park Forest, Richton Park, Olympia Fields, Flossmoor, Homewood, Hazel Crest, Markham, Midlothian, Oak Forest, Alsip, Bridgeview, Chicago Ridge, Evergreen Park, Bedford Park, and surrounding areas. Also serves northwest Indiana commercial clients.
